about: Where each DBC a recording names (its manifest line's source.params.dbc_sha256) was committed, so stack.py can name the exact command that exports it into ~/sdv-cache/dbc/<sha256>.dbc when that copy is missing. Project-written. Each entry was read with a read-only git on Windows (git rev-parse <commit>:<path>, and the export's sha256 checked); stack.py checks a cached copy against both hashes. A sha256 missing here is refused with the command that lists the candidate commits: the stack never picks one.
